name: Camino Benedictus, Tihany-Pannonhalma-Lébény-Mosonmagyaróvár-Rajka
description_md:
The Camino Benedictus is a waymarked hiking route in HU that spans 207.8 km. This hard trail requires about 59 hours of walking time based on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.

The route features 2524 m of ascent and 2466 m of descent. It is signposted as STJ and belongs to an international waymarked hiking network. The path passes Tihany and Lake Balaton within 200 m. It also passes the Battle of Raab and Arrabona within 300 m.
